BETWEEN:-
 SURYA PRAKASH BHONDEKAR S/O SHRI BAIGULAL  BHONDEKAR, AGED ABOUT 25 YEARS, OCCUPATION:
 LABOUR R/O WARD NO. 15 VILLAGE KINHI P.S. AND  TEHSIL KIRNAPUR DISTRICT BALAGHAT (MADHYA  PRADESH)
 
 (BY SHRI SANJAY SHARMA - ADVOCATE)

AND  THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH THROUGH P.S.
 KIRNAPUR DISTRICT BALAGHAT (MADHYA PRADESH)
 
 (BY SHRI PRAMOD THAKRE - GOVT. ADVOCATE)
 This application coming on for admission this day, the   following:
 ORDER

This second bail application under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure has been filed by the applicant for grant of regular bail relating to FIR No. 86/2023 dated 25.03.2023 registered at Police Station Kirnapur District Balaghat (M.P.) for commission of offence under Section 21(2),
21(2),21(3) of the Banning of Unregulated Deposit Scheme Act, 2019 and section 420,
406,120-B,467,468,471 of IPC.

entities.text: Banning of Unregulated Deposit Scheme Act, 2019
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Applicant is in detention since 11.08.2023.

Applicant's first bail application was dismissed as withdrawn and not pressed vide order dated 22.09.2023 passed in M.Cr.C. No.39620/2023.
2.
As per the prosecution story complainant Akhilesh Dongre gave Rs.30,000/- to the present applicant and applicant handed-over a cheque of an amount of Rs.60,000/- signed by Ajay Tidke to him.
On returning back the cheque, applicant refused to return the money to the complainant.

sentences.text: After investigation charge sheet has already been filed.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that applicant has not committed any offence.
He is innocent.
He has been falsely implicated.
He is the first offender.
He has no criminal background.
Co-accused of the case are absconding.
There is no likelihood of speedy trial.

Therefore,
it is prayed that applicant may be released on bail.
4. On the other hand, learned Panel Lawyer for the State has opposed grant of bail on the ground that three other co-accused are absconding.
5. In this case after investigation charge sheet has already been filed.
Applicant is first offender.
Final conclusion of the trial will take considerable time.

Therefore, having taken into consideration all the facts and circumstances of the case but without expressing any opinion on the merit of the case, I am of the view that it is a case in which applicant may be released on bail.
Consequently, this bail application under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of bail filed on behalf of applicant, stands allowed.

6. It is directed that applicant - Surya Prakash Bhondekar be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.

He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C.
7.
This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case o f bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
Certified copy as per rules.

(DINESH KUMAR PALIWAL) JUDGE MKL Surya Prakash Bhondekar vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 17 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/13751088/
